name: It Has Come to Pass! (illustration, Revelation 16:17)
note: Full-page painted illustration on page 233 of the book Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand!, showing the seventh bowl of wrath (Revelation 16:17) poured from the sky onto a collapsing city. The publisher's caption reads "Those motivated by Satan's polluted 'air' must suffer the execution of Jehovah's righteous judgments." Artist and exact year are not stated on the source page.
